g_a805affaa51c.title: Add isSameOrigin helper to ufo, agreeing test cases first

anchorAsk.text: I want to add an `isSameOrigin(a, b)` helper to ufo. Before any implementation, write the test cases in a new test/same-origin.test.ts so we can agree on the semantics. Don't implement it yet.

g_412337283608.title: Fix joinURL so path segments append before the query string and hash

anchorAsk.text: Different thing first: joinURL appends segments after the query string. `joinURL("/api?v=2", "users")` gives "/api?v=2/users" but it should be "/api/users?v=2" (same idea for a #hash). Can you fix that, with tests?
